vasta bibliografia disponível para o assunto de hidrato a sua possível presença em linhas de exportação de gás é sempre desagradável pela ausência de informações precisas sobre o problema real onde múltiplas causas geram um mesmo efeito e não existe forma direta de avaliação sobre o conservadorismo das soluções adotadas Após a identificação do bloqueio a análise do perfil da taxa de pressurização se mostrou uma ferramenta de grande valor para identificação e qualificação de eventos principalmente a distinção entre bloqueios oscilações da malha de gás eficiência no deslocamento de MEG formação de selo de liquido entre outro O procedimento adotado para a remoção do hidrato se mostrou eficiente principalmente por não impactar outras unidades mantendo as perdas restrita ao próprio FPSO A formação temporária de bloqueio mostrou que a inibição foi muito próxima do mínimo volume viável de MEG Tendo em vista as desvantagens quanto a utilização de PIG para carreamento do MEG neste caso específico as manobras com válvulas submarinas e de topside se mostraram eficientes para uma melhor distribuição de MEG no duto comprovadas pela variação na taxa de pressurização entre os ciclos Palavras-chave: Incrustação, Inibidor, Depósitos Inorgânicos, Modelagem, Compatibilidade ABSTRACT The formation of inorganic salt deposits, known as scale in oil industry, is one of the most serious and important flow assurance problems which injection systems are generally engaged in. Scale sometimes limits or blocks oil production by plugging the formation matrix, fractures or perforated intervals. Scale also deposits in several production and water injection equipments and facilities. The most common types of scale are barium and strontium sulfates, and calcium and magnesium carbonates. While sulfate scale precipitated due to a mixture of water from the sea, rich in sulfate, and brine rich in barium and strontium ions; carbonates are precipitated due to changes in saturation, which is very sensitive to changes in temperature, pressure and pH. The objective of this study is to gather the information found in the literature on the inorganic scale, by conducting a literature review that contains a summary of the topic, the approach to the problem, the mitigation methods. In addition to a case study of appointment of two scale inhibitors. Key words: Scale, Inhibitor, Inorganic Deposits, Modeling, Compatibility LISTA DE ILUSTRAÇÕES Figura 1 – Incrustação por sulfato de bário (BaSO4) na coluna de produção. system overdesign and chemical injection overdosage can have a significant impact on the technical and financial viability of the development: Cost of the dedicated MEG injection line and subsea distribution architecture Cost of the onshore or topside process modules for reclamation regeneration and storage Operating cost of process losses typically <NUMBER> of the injected volumetric flow maintain suitable velocities in the production flowline and to prevent excessive liquid accumulation resulting in increased erosion risk and compression costs Production impact due to higher backpressure on the production wells leading to lower flow rates in midlife limited tail-end production and reduced reservoir recovery A solution to address the uncertainties that lead to system overdesign and reduce operating performance is configuring the subsea production system with the optimal metering and sensor configuration to enable monitoring and optimization of the inhibition efficiency The components that make up the optimal configuration for flow assurance management are as follows: A water analysis sensor to detect and characterize the water in the flow stream The About this API-6A standard have addressed design validation and PVT based on performance requirements PR where major valve manufacturers for oil industry have widely adopted PR-2 as minimum on their performance verification tests In addition some industrial valves already pass through similar design verification processes on specific features such as Fugitive Emissions Although these design validation tests have better demonstrated performance and reliability on subsea on Christmas tree and on wellhead related valves topside valves are not covered by such standards or specifications and do not benefit from them Also they do not cover several valve types also used on topside facilities An initiative to overcome this constraint stablishing PVT requirements for a wider scope of valves was made with Brazilian standard ABNT-NBR <NUMBER> improving compatibility for several design and test requirements Rio Oil & Gas Expo and Conference <NUMBER> Design validation through performance view of the topside facility which initially serves the purpose of: <NUMBER> determining of the severity of the microbial contamination <NUMBER> locating the optimal location for organic biocide addition <NUMBER> optimizing biocide treatment strategy Also the audit allows for an evaluation of the total package of functional chemical dosing This is important because a decision to change the dosing of one functional chemical corrosion inhibitor biocide oxygen scavenger can have a substantial impact the other chemicals applied Some examples include compatibility issues and cross-reaction events The integrated audit to be described in this paper revealed several issues and allowed the optimization of not only the biocide dosage scheme but also laid out a path forward to optimize the dosing plan regarding multiple functional chemicals It should be noted that there is not a one-size-fits-all solution even for oilfields and top-side facilities which are in the same proximity Chemical engineering parameters such as salinity temperature nature of the hydrocarbons hydraulic retention time chemical compatibility and selected dosing points will uniquely determine the best total dosing scheme for functional chemicals Therefore the development of such an improved total chemical package for a topside asset requires close collaboration of the supplier of performance chemicals the service company and the operator In this paper the outcomes and conclusions of a field audit performed on a large Argentinian top-side oilfield facility are discussed The objective was
